title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Glistening crystals of frost cling to the branches of a lone spruce, weighing the branches down with their sheer numbers.  The tree is a splash of blue-green color in a domain of the woods gone brown and skeletal from the unrelenting cold.  The old stalwart seems little disturbed by the decay around it, glinting brightly in its icy garb.
